breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the contradiction. The original prompt requested a "variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax)" but then incorrectly stated to "Keep the lattice vectors fixed during the ionic relaxation". The ground truth resolves this by removing the incorrect instruction to fix the lattice vectors. The agent's generated specification repeats the error, stating both to perform a "vc-relax" and to "keep the lattice vectors fixed," which are mutually exclusive instructions.
